scope: all 180 unique completed original worktree trials; direct events aggregation; no model calls or evaluator re-scoring

definitions.rejected: count experiment/rejected once, using its own params.phase and params.category
definitions.delivered_setup: experiment/packet with params.phase=language_setup; joined response/applied phase is setup
definitions.actions: actual successful experiment/applied actions; attempted actions are reported separately from raw response envelopes
definitions.revise_cleared_existing: experiment/submissions_invalidated with nonempty cleared_agents, independently matched to reconstructed live submissions at that event
definitions.cleared_submission_count: sum of cleared_agents sizes; may differ from revise event count
